assessments.quote: A modified Residual UNet model was developed for liver segmentation using the 3Dircadb dataset, the model demonstrated excellent performance by achieving a Dice Score of 93.08%
assessments.reason: Proposes modified ResUNet for liver segmentation with quantitative results on 3Dircadb; directly on task.

assessments.quote: We consider a U-Net architecture with residual connections to capture fine-grained anatomical details.
assessments.reason: U-Net with residual connections for liver segmentation, two datasets, accuracy results; directly relevant.

assessments.quote: We demonstrate RMA-Mamba’s effectiveness in the challenging domain of pathological liver segmentation (from both CT and MRI)
assessments.reason: Novel RMA-Mamba architecture for pathological liver segmentation with Dice/IoU results on CirrMRI600+ and LiTS.

assessments.quote: This paper proposes an improved UNet architecture (RR UNet) for liver segmentation in CT images.
assessments.reason: Improved UNet (RR UNet) for liver segmentation with LiTS2017 metrics; directly on task.

assessments.quote: We show that the synthetic data can help improve the performance of the liver segmentation network.
assessments.reason: Focus is cross-modality synthesis to improve liver segmentation; segmentation is downstream, not the primary method contribution.

assessments.quote: This article aims to present a systematic literature review on modern image segmentation methods in mammography.
assessments.reason: Mammography segmentation review, not liver segmentation.

assessments.quote: Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures
assessments.reason: Review of AI in chronic hepatitis B; mentions liver segmentation only as one aspect, not a segmentation methods paper.

assessments.quote: TS-Portable achieved noninferior abdominal organ segmentation accuracy compared with the reference implementation
assessments.reason: Multiorgan (15-organ) segmentation including liver, but task is whole-abdominal organ segmentation and deployment, not liver-specific.

assessments.quote: we present a lightweight robotic liver ultrasound system with a 588-g decoupled end-effector controlled by a sonographer-informed AI agent
assessments.reason: Robotic ultrasound acquisition, not image segmentation.

assessments.quote: This study proposes WavPAC-Net, an innovative wavelet-based fusion network
assessments.reason: Hybrid CNN-Transformer wavelet network for liver segmentation with comparisons to 20 SOTA models and Dice results.

assessments.quote: This study focuses on classifying liver CT slices into Tumor and No-Tumor classes using deep learning.
assessments.reason: Classification of tumor vs no-tumor slices, not liver segmentation.

assessments.quote: This chapter introduces the concept of functional anatomy.
assessments.reason: Anatomy textbook chapter, not segmentation research.
